Hero.headline: Your journey to a pain-free life starts here
Hero.subheadline: Professional physiotherapy with an individual approach. I will help you rediscover the joy of movement and live fully.

Services.title: How I Can Help
Services.subtitle: I offer comprehensive care tailored to your needs. Every treatment is individual and focused on the root cause.
Services.back_pain_desc: Comprehensive diagnosis and therapy for back, neck and spine pain with long-lasting results.
Services.post_op_desc: Gentle and effective rehabilitation after joint, spine and other orthopedic surgeries.
Services.sport_desc: Prevention and treatment of sports injuries, return to activity and performance optimization.
Services.headache_desc: Manual therapy focused on releasing tension and eliminating the causes of chronic headaches.
Services.pregnancy_desc: Care for pregnant women, birth preparation and postpartum pelvic floor rehabilitation.
Services.posture_desc: Analysis and correction of poor posture, prevention of problems caused by sedentary lifestyles.

About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: Movement is a medicine we all have available.
About.story_p1: Since childhood, I have been fascinated by the human body and its ability to regenerate. After my own sports injury, I realized how essential proper care and approach to movement are.
About.story_p2: I believe in a holistic approach. I don't just address the symptoms; I look for the real cause of the problem. Together, we will find a way to bring your body back into balance.

Move.title: The M.O.V.E. Concept
Move.subtitle: A unique combination of physiotherapy, movement, and mental coaching for lasting results.
Move.m_desc: Everything starts in the mind. Together we will find your inner 'why' that will drive you forward, even when it gets tough. Your motivation is the fuel for successful therapy.
Move.o_desc: The courage to overcome pain and the fear of movement. I will help you regain trust in your own body and abandon movement stereotypes that no longer serve you.
Move.v_desc: Change doesn't happen overnight. Perseverance and consistency are the keys to lasting relief and health. I will support you every step of the way.
Move.e_desc: The result of our effort is the return of life energy. A pain-free body means the freedom to live fully and enjoy everyday activities.

Contact.title: Contact & Booking
Contact.subtitle: Ready to get started? Reach out to me and we will find a date together.
